summary: The diff implements a comprehensive frontend redesign with clean minimalist aesthetics, including layout refinements, card-based UI components, discovery sections, search filtering, and a warm earth-tone color system. However, many critical backend features and full frontend requirements remain unimplemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement campus verification system supporting both .edu email verification and manual campus selection during onboarding, storing campus affiliation in user profiles
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of campus verification logic, .edu email validation, onboarding campus selection UI, or backend validation in the diff

missing_requirements.requirement: Enable sellers to upload multiple photos per listing (up to 5 images), manage pricing, mark items as sold, and control inventory status with an intuitive listing management interface
missing_requirements.reason: No drag-and-drop photo reordering, no sold status toggle UI, no My Listings page showing inventory status clearly

missing_requirements.requirement: Create comprehensive user profile pages displaying seller ratings, listing history, verification badges, campus affiliation, and trust indicators
missing_requirements.reason: No profile page component showing active/sold listings, seller ratings, verification badges, or campus affiliation in the diff

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement buyer-seller messaging system with thread-based conversations, typing indicators, read receipts, and quick offer buttons for seamless communication
missing_requirements.reason: No typing indicators, read receipts, or quick offer button implementations visible in the diff

missing_requirements.requirement: Add price suggestion feature that analyzes item condition, category, and comparable listings to recommend optimal pricing when creating or editing listings
missing_requirements.reason: No price suggestion logic, no analysis of condition/category/comparable listings, no UI for accepting or overriding suggested prices

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement urgent sale tags for end-of-semester listings, allowing sellers to mark listings as time-sensitive and prioritizing them in search results and feeds
missing_requirements.reason: No urgent sale toggle UI, no urgent sale badge display, no prioritization logic in search results or feeds

missing_requirements.requirement: Add campus meetup location suggestions feature that recommends safe, public meeting spots on campus when buyers and sellers arrange transactions
missing_requirements.reason: Campus meetup locations array exists in ListingDetailsPage.tsx but no UI for selecting locations in chat or listing detail, no safety tips accompaniment

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement saved searches feature allowing users to save search queries with filters and receive notifications when new listings match their saved criteria
missing_requirements.reason: No saved searches UI, no ability to save current query/filters, no backend matching logic, no notifications for matches

missing_requirements.requirement: Redesign home page with a premium dashboard layout featuring personalized listing recommendations, quick action cards, recently viewed items strip, trending section, and campus-specific widgets
missing_requirements.reason: HomePage.tsx includes quick actions, stats, trending, and recommended sections, but no campus-specific widgets or explicit recently viewed items strip visible

missing_requirements.requirement: Redesign listing detail pages with large image carousels, clear pricing and condition display, prominent save and cart actions, seller profile preview, chat button, and integrated safety tips
missing_requirements.reason: ListingDetailsPage.tsx shows some elements but seller profile card with rating/verification status is not clearly implemented, safety tips banner integration unclear

hallucinated_features.description: Insights route and page added to router configuration
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 through REQ-14 do not mention any insights, analytics, or insights page feature

hallucinated_features.description: Cart functionality with add/remove/count and cart badge on bottom tabs
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement mentions a shopping cart feature; the BuildRequest focuses on marketplace listings, messaging, and profiles, not cart-based checkout

hallucinated_features.description: Notifications bell icon and notifications route in TopBar
hallucinated_features.reason: While REQ-10 mentions notifications for saved searches, a general notifications page with bell icon was not explicitly requested
